snippet.title: Ever Spire - Official Trailer | One Tower. Endless Waves.
snippet.description:
One tower. Endless waves. Every choice can change your run.

Ever Spire is a medieval fantasy roguelite tower defense game. Defend a central tower from incoming enemy waves, shape your build between fights, and see how long your strategy can hold.

Choose your hero — Barbarian, Mage, or Templar. Combine Fire, Frost, and Lightning: a second element can awaken during a run and open up new reactions. Choose a card every five waves, discover relics, gear up your hero, and build synergies that can transform your run.

• Story Mode: 50 waves, 4 biomes, and 5 bosses
• Endless Mode with Torment difficulty tiers
• Daily challenge and weekly boss
• Gear, sets, and legendary items

Which hero and element would you take into your first run? Tell us in the comments — and subscribe for more Ever Spire reveals.

Ever Spire is developed by Onmitsu.
